title: Ethiopian-Inspired Skillet Curry
description: A vegan skillet curry with a light, exotic flavor profile inspired by Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the curds and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Ethiopian spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Ethiopian spice blend if desired.
